description.zh:
集群ID。
>您可以通过[describedbclusters](~~98094~~)接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息（如集群ID）。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh:
强制指定获取指定时间粒度的数据，支持**60**（分钟）、**3600**（小时）。
- **Interval**=**60**：最长可查询最近一个月的数据，单次查询的时间跨度最长为7天。
- **Interval**=**3600**：最长可查询最近一个月的数据，单次查询的时间跨度最长为7天。
description.en:
The time granularity of the data to retrieve. Valid values: **60** (minutes) and **3600** (hours).

- If you set **Interval** to **60**, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days.
- If you set **Interval** to **3600**, you can query data from the last month. The maximum time range for a single query is 7 days.

description.zh: 查询开始时间。格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-aidb-cluster-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --key PolarDBAIModelCall --start-time 2025-09-17T02:18:00Z --end-time 2025-09-23T01:01:00Z --interval 60 --region cn-hangzhou
